poema.texto:
Corruption weaves its spell, so deep inside
Our political landscape, it just won't divide
A society stricken by inequality,
Where the rich get richer, and the poor must rely on charity.

The labour force, easily exploited and suppressed,
Employers thumbing their noses with impunity suppressed.
A healthcare system, faltering with age,
While the rich enjoy exclusive private cures.

The environment, poisoned by greed, uncontrolled.
Only the wealthy see the world as their gallery, controlled.

We, the people, confined in our dreams,
Suffering silently in this unjust schemes.
The young generation, lost in hopefulness,
The older ones, resigned to enduring the twilight.

Change is not enough, oh no!
Until we break the vicious cycle that we mold.

Espinela crítica al sistema,
Hacia una sociedad más justa y justicia en orden.
